newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms London Insurance after Royal buyout.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms London Insurance after Royal buyout.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service on Friday said it reaffirmed the ratings of London Insurance Group following its acquistion by the Royal Bank of Canada.
The bond rating agency said it confirmed London's commercial paper rating at A-1, unsubordinated debentures at A+(Low), preferred shares at P-1 and non-cumulative preferred shares at P-2.

CBRS said it also confirmed the ratings of London Insurance's wholly owned London Life unit. London Life has an investment strength rating of AA++, a commercial paper rating of A-1+ and a preferred share rating of P-1.

It was expected that London Life's operations would be enhanced through its association with Royal Bank, CBRS said. The agency said it also expected that London Life's revenue base would grow because its agents could offer a larger array of products.
CBRS said London Life had a very favorable capital structure well in excess of regulatory requirements.
